timeline.summary: Achal Anil Bakeri, Rupa Achal Bakeri, and promoter group entities declared no encumbrance on Symphony Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Symphony GST appeal for FY2018 drastically reduced to ₹0.28 lakh from ₹2.65 Cr
Symphony announced an Australia balance sheet reset with ₹259 Cr impairments, acquisition of CTPL IPRs for ₹23 Cr, and Bonaire USA LLC for ₹30 Cr.
Symphony Limited’s Board proposed ₹5/share final dividend (₹2/- face value) for FY25-26, totaling ~₹62 crore.
On May 16, 2026, Symphony announced an upcoming media interaction with CNBC TV 18 regarding FY26 financial results.
Chimanbha Barvadiya and Mayur Barvadiya uploaded Q4 and FY2026 earnings call audio recording on May 18, 2026, per SEBI listing rules.
Symphony reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹338 Cr and announced a balance sheet reset with full impairment of its Australia business.
Symphony completed the ₹52 Cr acquisition of Bonaire USA LLC and related IPRs from its Australian subsidiary CTPL to facilitate debt reduction at the subsidiary level.
Symphony Limited has arranged a Results Conference Call through Nirmal Bang Institutional Equities on October 29, 2026, at 16:00 hours (IST) to discuss Unaudited Financial Results for Q2FY27.
Results Conference Call for Q2FY27 rescheduled to 29 October 2026 at 15:00 hours (IST).
Symphony Limited declared 2nd Interim Dividend of ₹2 per equity share on 29 Oct 2026.
Board of Directors approved a second interim dividend of ₹2 per share for FY 2026–27, effective October 29, 2026.
Symphony finalised the sale of vacant freehold land at Bodakdev, Ahmedabad, for ₹27.00 Cr against a carrying value of ₹5.68 Cr.
